This document is a technical README-style overview of the "Project Maya" local LLM inference project. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Three main model families: GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, each offered in multiple sizes (e.g., Maya-XS, Maya-S, Maya-S24, Maya-M, Maya-L).
- MiniMax sizes: Maya-XS (~93 GB, fits a 128 GB PC), Maya-S (~122 GB, closer to original).
